query: SELECT r.started AS "started!", EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.conversation_id=$1 AND e.seq>r.started AND e.call_id IS NOT NULL) AS "tools!", (SELECT MIN(e.seq) FROM events e WHERE e.conversation_id=$1 AND e.seq>r.started AND e.step=(SELECT MAX(s.step) FROM events s WHERE s.conversation_id=$1 AND s.seq>r.started)) AS answer_from FROM (SELECT MAX(seq) AS started FROM events WHERE conversation_id=$1 AND lifecycle='run.started') r WHERE r.started IS NOT NULL
